shared_elements: low relief carving of figures on a flat surface
quadruped animal with four legs and tail
justification: Both surfaces carry low-relief profile figures organized into horizontal registers, and both include quadrupeds and at least one anthropomorphic/bird-headed figure, but these are generic correspondences. A depicts a specific narrative scene — a rider/charioteer behind a harnessed horse with a spoked wheel, an attendant, and a fallen body underfoot — whereas B shows a non-narrative array of schematic animals, a row of repeated arch/loop signs and a large bird with outspread form, with no vehicles, weapons or trampled enemy.
